cohort: The study participants were female dogs undergoing C-section due to either primary uterine inertia (n = 12) or obstructive dystocia (n = 8).
finding: Primary uterine inertia (PUI) was associated with significantly higher OXTR and PGR expressions in uterine tissue compared to obstructive dystocia (OD), and PUI was not related to higher P4 levels.
